label: [verse]
lyrics:
[verse]
In the quiet room where shadows play,
An old man lies, his hair turned gray.
Memories flicker, like lights that fade,
Within the walls where time has stayed.

[chorus]
Do you remember, the days gone by?
When dreams were young and spirits high.
With every note, her voice takes flight,
A marching band ignites the night.

[bridge]
Flashbacks dance, of laughter sweet,
Of battles fought and hearts that beat.
Dancing on a hillside under skies so wide,
Through fields of gold, through stormy weather,
Moments cherished, binding us forever.
tags: bittersweet, powerful, ethereal, piano, strings, marching band, moderate tempo, Florence and the Machine style

label: [chorus]
lyrics:
[chorus]
The one I'm missing is you
In every moment, in all I do
I feel your absence anew
Wishing you were here, too

[verse]
Walking down these lonely streets
Memories linger where we used to meet
Every corner holds a trace of you
A silhouette against the sky so blue

[bridge]
Time moves on, but it doesn't heal
The void remains, an open seal
Hoping someday our paths will cross again
Until then, my heart won't settle or bend

The calm before the storm arrives,

Explosions echo through the night,
As dawn breaks, we stand united.

Beneath the stormy sky.
Feel the thunder, hear the cry,

Neon lights they flicker bright
City hums in dead of night
Rhythms pulse through concrete veins
Lost in echoes of refrains

Bassline groovin' in my chest
Heartbeats match the city's zest
Electric whispers fill the air
Synthesized dreams everywhere

Voices blend in harmony

Timeless echoes timeless cries
Soulful shouts beneath the skies

Keyboard dances on the keys
Melodies on evening breeze
Catch the tune and hold it tight
In this moment we take flight

label: [verse]
lyrics:
[verse]
On a ferris wheel, we soared so high
The world below, under starlit sky
I gave you a rose, our hearts aligned
Little did we know, fate would unwind

[chorus]
Why did reality tear us apart?
Leaving scars that won't heal or start
I need something to fuel my fight
Yet all I feel is this endless night

[verse]
Now every spin feels like a fall
Without your laughter, without it all
Stress from the world tore us asunder
Dreams we had, shattered like thunder

[chorus]
Why did reality tear us apart?
Leaving scars that won't heal or start
I need something to fuel my fight
Yet all I feel is this endless night

[bridge]
Someday I'll ride that ferris wheel again
Hold another rose, find love not pain
Until then, in sorrow I confide
Memories linger, where dreams reside

[chorus]
Why did reality tear us apart?
Leaving scars that won't heal or start
I need something to fuel my fight
Yet all I feel is this endless night

label: [verse]
lyrics:
[verse]
I've been lost in the echoes of your words
Cut deeper than any blade, left me in pain
You took my heart and threw it away
Left me here with nothing to say

[chorus]
But I'll rise from these ashes, find my way back home
I am more than your cruel goodbye, I'll never be alone
With every tear, I'll water the seeds of a brand new start
And though you're gone, I'll heal this broken heart

[verse]
Every scar tells a story of who I used to be
But now I'm writing chapters you'll never take from me
I won't let your shadow darken my skies anymore
I'll walk into the sunrise, leave you on the shore

[chorus]
But I'll rise from these ashes, find my way back home
I am more than your cruel goodbye, I'll never be alone
With every tear, I'll water the seeds of a brand new start
And though you're gone, I'll heal this broken heart

[bridge]
This pain will pass, like everything does
I'll find strength in the cracks, become enough
Your harsh words won't define me, they'll fade away
I'll dance in the rain, find joy in each day

[chorus]
I'll rise from these ashes, find my way back home
I am more than your cruel goodbye, I'll never be alone
With every tear, I'll water the seeds of a brand new start
And though you're gone, I'll heal this broken heart

[outro]
The sun will shine again, brighter than before
I'll open up my wings and soar

Techno beats pulse through circuits and wires
